Name: Stable Chic Decor
Author: Kayyteee
Description:
[center][font=Courier New][size=4][b][u]Do you love your horse? Do you want to care for your horse? [/u]
[/b][/size]
Well here are some cute decor for you to help your friend feel more cozy and loved.
This mod adds two different wood alternative for each decor piece except the big wheel and metal buckets. 
You can use the furnitures indoors or outdoors to create your ideal horse stable.
[/font][size=3][b]
[u][/u][/b][/size][/center][center][font=Courier New][u][size=3][b]Mod installation:
[/b][/size][/u]
-Download the mod and all dependencies
-Place files into your mod files
-Load the game and purchase the catalogue from robin
-Have fun![/font]

[font=Courier New][size=3][b][u]Compatibility:
[/u][/b][/size]
This mod is for SDV 1.6 - it is not compatible with older versions of the game. This mod is not tested on mobile,
This mod is fully compatible with all other furniture mods and if there is any problem do give me a message.

Compatible with happy home designer.

[size=3][b][u]Translation:
[/u][/b][/size]
This mod is currently only in english.
I'm forever grateful if anyone is happy to translate it into another language but it isn't required.


[b][size=3][u]My Ko-Fi: [/u][/size][/b]
https://ko-fi.com/kayyteee
[/font][/center]
